name: Heartland Howloween
description: Heartland Howloween is a furry convention in Omaha, Nebraska, organized by Heartland Furries and Azelian Events. It began as a micro-convention and multi-state potluck on October 26, 2024, at the First United Methodist Church, with 154 attendees, and in 2025 it became a hotel convention billed as a "furry/raver fusion", with all-ages and 18+ raves. In 2026 it moved to the DoubleTree hotel in downtown Omaha and grew to 723 attendees, supporting the Ponca Tribe of Nebraska.
